agg_loss = sum(weighted_loss)
adv_sum = sum(weighted_adv) + eps
adv_prob = weighted_adv / adv_sum
adv_entropy = -sum(adv_prob * log(adv_prob + eps))

    weight = batch['weight']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))

    logits = ops.clamp(logits, -20.0, 20.0)

    zeros = ops.zeros_like(logits)
    stacked_logits = ops.stack([zeros, logits], dim=1)
    logsumexp_vals = ops.logsumexp(stacked_logits, dim=1)

    loss_terms = ops.add(ops.neg(logits), logsumexp_vals)

    final_loss = ops.add(agg_loss, reg_loss)
    return final_loss

    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    entropy_w = batch['entropy_w']
    entropy_l = batch['entropy_l']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))
    entropy_coeff = float(extra.get('entropy_coeff', 0.01))
    eps = 1e-12

    # Margin loss with clamped logits
    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, advantage_gap))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    weighted_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    base_loss = ops.div(weighted_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))

    # Compute entropy and advantage deviations for covariance

    weighted_entropy_sum = ops.sum(ops.mul(entropy, weight))
    weighted_adv_sum = ops.sum(ops.mul(advantage_gap, weight))

    entropy_mean = ops.div(weighted_entropy_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))
    adv_mean = ops.div(weighted_adv_sum, ops.add(weight_sum, eps))

    entropy_diff = ops.sub(entropy, entropy_mean)
    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_gap, adv_mean)

    cov = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(ops.mul(entropy_diff, adv_diff), weight)), ops.add(weight_sum, eps))
